newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Dec 27.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Dec 27.

text.p: All major ports were open as of 1000 local/1600 GMT, the Communications and Transportation Ministry said in a daily update.
The ministry updated port and shipping conditions for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

Tropical damp air creating light clouds over the coasts of Sinaloa, Nayarit, Jalisco, Colima, Michoacan and Guerrero and a high pressure system forming over the peninsula of Baja California and Sonora. Winds from the northeast of 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 kilometers/11 to 17 miles per hour) and waves up to 5 feet.

Stationary front has edged northwards, causing scarce light rains over the coasts of Veracruz, Tamaulipas, and the Yucatan peninsula. Winds from the east and northeast at 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 kilometers/11 to 17 miles per hour).
Clouds causing light rains along the coasts of Quintana Roo state and Central America. Winds from the east and northeast at 10 to 15 knots with waves three to six feet high.
